ayahOccurrences.text: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: nominative masculine plural (form IV) passive participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُّقْمَحُونَ is in the derivative form: مُقْمَحُون
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/م/ح   q–m–ḥ to twist the neck; to be humbled, debased or forced into submission; (said of animals) to refuse to drink, to drink one’s fill. Of this root, مُقْمَحُون muqmaḥūn occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُقْمَحُون muqmaḥūn [pl. of pass. part. مُقْمَحُ muqmaḥ] those who raise the head in refusal of what is being offered, shun assistance, shun guidance; ones who cannot see

(36:8) إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِى أَعْنَاقِهِمْ أَغْلاَلا فَهِيَ إِلَى الأَذْقَانِ فَهُمْ مُقْمَحُونَ We have placed fetters on their necks, right up to their chins, so they have their heads forced up.
